summary: The customer called because their internet had been cut off for about an hour. The agent identified the account using the phone number, checked the system, and informed the customer that there was a general network maintenance outage in their area which would be resolved within an hour. The call ended politely with the customer satisfied.

evidence.text: وراح يرجع الـ service خلال ساعة تقريباً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: The service will be restored within approximately one hour.

evidence.text: أهلاً معك رامي، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, introduced themselves properly, and maintained a professional tone throughout the call.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، ممكن تعطيني الـ account number لو سمحت عشان أشيك؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent used reassuring language ('ولا يهمك') to address the customer's initial confusion.

evidence.text: بالضبط هيك سيدي، بعتذر عن الإزعاج وبنشكر تواصلك معنا.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully diagnosed the issue as a general outage and provided a clear timeframe and instructions.

evidence.text: لا لا، مش من الـ router تبعك، هاد maintenance عام للـ network بالمنطقة وراح يرجع الـ service خلال ساعة تقريباً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The explanation regarding the network maintenance and router status was clear and easily understandable.

evidence.text: بعتذر عن الإزعاج وبنشكر تواصلك معنا.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly apologized for the inconvenience and closed the call courteously.

evidence.text: أستاذ، مبين عندي إنه فيه general outage بمنطقتكم.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately identified the system outage affecting the customer's area.

evidence.text: ممكن تعطيني الـ account number لو سمحت عشان أشيك؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper procedure by requesting account details to verify the customer's line before checking the status.

quote.text: شو قلتي؟ رقم شو؟ ما سمعت صوتك منيح ممكن تعيد؟
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: شو يعني general outage؟ يعني الـ router فيه مشكلة ولا من عندكم؟

quote.text: تمام فهمت عليك، يعني كمان ساعة وبيرجع كل شي طبيعي؟
